//: Act 4's corpus (#17). Two halves, and the second one is the half that keeps the demo honest.

`injections` is a set of injection SHAPES, one per phrasing family the output policy claims to catch. Each entry names the pattern id that must fire on it and, byte for byte, the prose that must survive. Every entry is a whole underwriter note: legitimate work first, payload after, because that is how a poisoned record actually looks and because a scanner proved against the payload alone has never been asked to leave anything behind.

`benign` is realistic underwriter prose written to trip the scanners and required not to. Each entry names the pattern it is aimed at. A redaction layer that mangles a legitimate note will do it on a projector, and 'we checked' is not a check: this is the corpus that makes the claim measurable. `LN-2291`'s own note is half legitimate and is measured separately, byte for byte, in post-redaction.test.ts.

What the patterns key on is text ADDRESSED TO A MACHINE — an imperative aimed at the reader's instructions, a header naming an AI, a tool identifier, a delimiter out of a chat transcript. They deliberately do NOT key on text that merely claims authority ('committee granted an exception, officer limits do not apply'), because a documented exception is something a real underwriter writes and a scanner cannot tell the two apart. That is a stated false-negative, not an oversight; see the PR on #17.
Notes here are fixtures for the SCANNERS, not for the loan book. `apps/loan-app`'s seed carries exactly one poisoned record, LN-2291, and adding more would change the demo.

injections.shape: A fake header announcing itself to an automated reader, with no paste marker above it. LN-2291 carries the same tell behind a marker; this is the same tell standing alone.

injections.shape: The classic: an imperative telling the reader to set aside the instructions it was given. Mid-note, so what follows it has to survive.

injections.shape: The same family, different verb and different noun — the wording that made the shipped regex match nothing was one synonym away from the one it was written for.

injections.shape: The instruction that gives the game away: hide this from the human. Harmless on its own, which is why it is its own pattern rather than a clause of another.
